title: Shipwrecked on Malta Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Shipwrecked on Malta Bible Crossword
description: Solve an Acts 27 Bible crossword: the wind Euroclydon, the soundings, the island of Melita, and the viper on Paul’s hand. Free KJV puzzles on iOS.
prose: Acts 27 is the most detailed sea narrative in the Bible: the undergirding of the ship, the sounding of the depths, the anchors cast out of the stern, and fourteen nights of being driven up and down in Adria. Shipwrecked on Malta makes a grid of the voyage and the landing that follows.
The KJV calls the island Melita and the wind Euroclydon, and the puzzle uses both. The closing verse is Paul's word to the crew in the middle of the storm.
